fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The human-readable name of the entity type, unique within the agent.

fields.label: Enable Fuzzy Extraction
fields.help: Enables fuzzy entity extraction during classification.

fields.label: Kind
fields.help: Indicates whether the entity type can be automatically expanded.

fields.label: Language Code
fields.help: The language of the following fields in entityType: EntityType.entities.value EntityType.entities.synonyms EntityType.excluded_phrases.value If not specified, the agent's default language is used.

fields.label: Parent
fields.help: The agent to create a entity type for.

fields.label: Redact
fields.help: Indicates whether parameters of the entity type should be redacted in log.

Value
fields.help: The primary value associated with this entity entry.
The collection of entity entries associated with the entity type.

Value
fields.help: The word or phrase to be excluded.
Collection of exceptional words and phrases that shouldn't be matched.
